description: Header file defining a template-based message exchange mechanism with Type-Length-Value serialization, including classes for request, response, buffer handling, and a core message exchange type with synchronization and data transmission logic.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: Template struct implementing Type-Length-Value serialization with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: Template class managing message exchange with synchronization, data sending/receiving, and state handling.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another request buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next data block in the buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into internal buffer.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the communication channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the communication channel.

methods.name: ClaimSlot
methods.description: Claims a slot for message processing with timeout.

methods.name: CompletedSlot
methods.description: Marks a message slot as completed.
